caption: The drawing depicts ten diamond-shaped objects arranged in two horizontal rows, with five diamonds in each row, set against a plain, beige background. Each diamond contains a distinct pattern or design. The diamonds feature a variety of colors including blue, green, pink, purple, black, beige, and yellow. Some diamonds have floral patterns in blue and yellow or pink, others have geometric or striped patterns in colors such as green, beige, purple, pink, and yellow, while some are solid colored or contain simple abstract designs. The diamonds are grouped together so that their pointed tips touch or nearly touch each other, forming a compact composition in the center of the drawing. Below the diamonds, the text "WESTCHESTER COUNTY" is written on the left side, and "MAUD SCHMID" is written on the right side, both in uppercase letters.
title: Printed Quilt Patterns
